prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object approached, then take and check it, perform task if possible, otherwise approach or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = DoTask    /> <SubTree ID = FindTakeAndDoTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO DoTask
	END
